capability: Report per-layer two-dimensional LINE/CIRCLE/ARC bounds with explicit geometric evidence.
user: CAD export maintainers checking a small planar model-space DXF.
pain: A whole-drawing bounding box does not explain which layer/entity caused an extent, especially on an arc crossing zero degrees.
expected: Exit 0: cut layer bounds are [-2,0,3,4]; reference circle bounds are [9,9,11,11]. Three entities on two layers.
contract: ASCII DXF with one ENTITIES section and complete section/EOF structure. Only LINE,CIRCLE,ARC in model space with zero Z/thickness and default extrusion. Arc sweeps are counterclockwise, normalized modulo360 and include endpoints plus cardinal extrema. Full/zero-turn arcs are rejected: use CIRCLE. All entities, including invisible ones, contribute raw geometry. Per-layer counts, bounds and approximate total lengths retain entity evidence; zero-length LINE is an exit1 finding.
limits: 2 MiB,50000 code/value pairs,10000 entities,256 layers,128-character layer names,1024-character tag values; finite coordinate/angle absolute magnitude<=1e9. Other sections are counted and ignored. Unsupported entities, transforms, duplicate geometry fields, layouts and missing coordinates fail explicitly. No blocks, polylines, text, clipping, units conversion, repair or manufacturing certificate. Bounds/lengths use floating point.
acceptance: Correct line/circle/cardinal arc extents,350-to10-degree sweep and layer unions; reject3D, nondefault extrusion, inserts, malformed sections and duplicate geometry tags.
notes: LibreCAD is a complete CAD application. Ezdxf already computes bounding boxes across far broader entity types, including transforms and curves. Libdxfrw provides broad DXF/DWG IO. This smaller strict report is a narrower interface, not an absent competitor feature.
overlap: The owned OBJ island audit analyzes triangle edge topology in3D. This tool analyzes different file semantics, layer identities and planar primitive bounds; no shared product was subdivided.
